units.source_text: 你我如此对晤，情谊本已甚深，此外尚复何求？”

en.t: You and I have met face to face like this, and our affection is already very deep; what more could I ask for?"

units.source_text: 夕雾微笑着说：“是浅是深，我想你心中一定明白。

en.t: Yugiri smiled and said, "Whether it is shallow or deep, I am sure you understand in your heart.

units.source_text: 照理说来，你身蒙圣眷，我岂敢妄想？

en.t: Strictly speaking, since you enjoy His Majesty's favor, how could I dare to harbor such hopes?

units.source_text: 但我心日夜煎熬，此情你不得而知。

en.t: But my heart is tormented day and night, and you cannot know this feeling.

units.source_text: 我怕说了出来，反而使你讨厌我，

en.t: I feared that if I spoke of it, I would only make you dislike me,

units.source_text: 所以一向苦苦地闷在心中，然而‘至今已不胜’其苦了。

en.t: so I have always painfully kept it shut inside my heart, yet by now I can no longer bear the suffering.

units.source_text: 柏木中将的心情你知道么？

en.t: Do you know how Lieutenant General Kashiwagi felt?

units.source_text: 我当时因是别人之事，对他漠不关心。

en.t: At the time, because it was someone else's affair, I was indifferent to him.

units.source_text: 现在轮到自己身上，方知当时何其愚笨。

en.t: Now that it has fallen upon me, I realize how foolish I was then.

units.source_text: 而柏木之心情也可理解了。

en.t: And now I can understand Kashiwagi's feelings as well.

units.source_text: 现在他倒已经梦醒，从此可以永远与你保持兄妹之谊，心情反而喜慰。

en.t: Now he has awakened from his dream, and because he can keep a brother-and-sister bond with you forever, he is instead comforted and pleased.

units.source_text: 我看了不胜妒羡呢。

en.t: Seeing that, I cannot help feeling envious.

units.source_text: 至少请你可怜我的苦心！”

en.t: At least, please take pity on the anguish in my heart!"

units.source_text: 他唠唠叨叨地说了许多话，但都可笑，故不记述。

en.t: He went on at great length, but it was all ridiculous, so it will not be recorded here.

units.source_text: 玉鬘心中不快，渐渐向后退却。

en.t: Tamakazura felt displeased and gradually drew back.

units.source_text: 夕雾又说：“你的心肠好硬啊！

en.t: Yugiri said again, "How hard-hearted you are!

units.source_text: 我从来不曾冒犯你，你总该知道吧。”

en.t: I have never offended you; surely you know that."

units.source_text: 他想乘此机会，再诉说些衷情，但闻玉鬘说：“我心绪很不好……”

en.t: He wanted to take this chance to say more of what was in his heart, but he heard Tamakazura say, "I am feeling very unwell..."

units.source_text: 说罢就退入内室。

en.t: After saying this, she withdrew into the inner room.

units.source_text: 他只得长叹一声，告辞而去。

en.t: He could only let out a long sigh, take his leave, and go away.
